an3.83:1.3: Idha bhikkhave kassako gahapati paṭigacc' eva khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ,
an3.83:1.4: paṭigacc' eva khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti,
an3.83:1.5: kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā samayena udakaṃ abhineti pi apaneti pi.
an3.83:1.6: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa pubbe karaṇīyāni. 2.
an3.83:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave tīṇ' imāni bhikkhussa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
an3.83:2.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi bhikkhussa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
an3.83:3.2: tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne ti. Evaṃ
an3.83:3.3: hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabban ti. 83. 1. Evaṃ
